'''Amminius Goodner''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] tasked a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] to locate Amminius Goodner on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], after he made indications of wishing to aid the Rebellion. However, it turned out to be a trap. When the Rebel activated a [[Computer/Legends|terminal]] in the [[Taikaha Hills]] to summon Goodner, he revealed his continued allegiance to the Empire. A fight between the Rebel and lieutenant ensued, resulting in Amminius' death.<ref name="SWG:MtS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Amminius Goodner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Amminius Goodner was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:MtS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
